name: Aaron, Event Finder
tagline: Finds date-verified local events near a ZIP and turns them into a day plan
description: Give it a ZIP code and a drive time, and it looks for events that really exist and are genuinely on the calendar. Paid, free, and RSVP-only all count. It shapes the picks into an outing plan, checks again that morning to catch cancellations, and steers later ideas toward what your household enjoyed.
author: FrederickPaiSu
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
